value.rationale: The natural Ritt diagnostic \(n\|P^n-P^{n-1}\|\) for probabilistic convolutions has an exact three-way phase diagram. Support-gcd resonance, drift and variance are intrinsic invariants, not arbitrary parameters. Sharp odd-order peripheral slopes and universal nonzero endpoint give quantitative information not provided by the existing qualitative Ritt/BAR criteria. The result is a complete motivated classification for nondegenerate finite-range measures, with prospects for comparison of numerical smoothing and lattice effects.
